# Moody Spurgeon MacPherson

[Queen’s Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is a funny-looking boy. He has a big, fat face, small blue eyes, and prominent ears that stick out like flaps.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## Personality

Moody Spurgeon aspires to become a minister, though he acknowledges that pursuing a trade like carpentry would be easier. He experiences anxiety regarding his academic performance, particularly fearing that he will fail English history.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P20](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0020)_

## Traits

- failing in English history  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028)</sub>

## History

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) who joins Miss Stacy's advanced class to prepare for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. After completing his schooling, he travels to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) alongside his peers to take the entrance exams. He later moves to town to attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with the rest of his fellow [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classmates.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P25](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P38](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII.
